gates.trigger: digital goods, ruby, tickets, subscriptions or feature unlocks
gates.requirement: Use applicable Apple IAP; purchased currency does not expire; restorable purchases have restore.
Disclose odds before purchase or draw; show rate-table version, pity, featured guarantee, carryover, exchange and ending rules.
Provide discoverable in-app full-account deletion initiation, transparent confirmation, billing explanation and disclosed legal retention.

gates.trigger: data collection, SDK, analytics, advertising or tracking
gates.requirement: App Privacy label and privacy policy match actual app and SDK flows; ATT precedes tracking; refusal does not gate core play.

gates.trigger: digital goods, currency, tickets, subscription or feature unlocks
gates.requirement: Use applicable Play Billing or documented eligible program; backend verifies purchase; PENDING grants nothing; PURCHASED grants once and is acknowledged.
Odds are disclosed before and in close proximity to purchase; indirect paid currency and paid tickets are included.
Process RTDN and API events idempotently and out of order; refund, revocation and restore reconcile server ledgers and entitlements.
Initial product uses rewarded opt-in only; no unexpected or disruptive ads, accidental-click placement, or battle/purchase/recovery interruption.

gates.trigger: user data, account, SDK or backend
gates.requirement: User Data policy, Data Safety and privacy policy match actual flows; account creation includes in-app deletion and public web resource.

gates.trigger: paid randomized acquisition and collection rewards
gates.requirement: Do not grant a separate economic benefit for completing a specific set of two or more distinct paid-random items; prohibit comp gacha.

gates.trigger: odds, price, discount, product content, pity, guarantee or limited-time claim
gates.requirement: Displayed terms match server and catalog reality; no fake discount, hidden zero rate, misleading mass-draw count or ambiguous value.

gates.trigger: paid ruby or other stored value
gates.requirement: Determine prepaid-payment-instrument applicability and obligations for issuer display, unused balance, filing or registration, safeguarding and termination refund.

gates.trigger: minors may access purchases or randomized items
gates.requirement: Age and guardian protections, clear pricing, purchase history, repeated-spend warnings, parental-control guidance and support/refund process are defined and tested.

gates.trigger: personal data, identifiers, analytics, ads, support or cross-border providers
gates.requirement: Purpose, minimization, security, processor supervision, third-party and cross-border transfer, rights response and incident response are mapped.

gates.trigger: submission or material SDK, catalog or provider change
gates.requirement: Refresh Apple and Google policies and Japanese legal review immediately before release; record versions and reviewer.
